_comment: Maps a Google Business Profile location to the Mezza Location_Name the sales feed uses. Google's own titles are almost all just 'Mezza Lebanese Kitchen' -- six of them in Halifax alone -- so the title is useless as a key and byTitle is left empty on purpose. These were matched on STREET ADDRESS, cross-checked against the Push Operations company labels (which are addresses) and store-mapping.json.
_note_two_accounts: Every location is reachable through two accounts: one organisation account holding all 23, plus a per-location account per store. The sync deduplicates on the location id; without that, every metric was counted twice.

excludeLocationIds.12151035443143094217: Production Centre, 63 Jim Connors Ave -- the 15,000 sq ft plant, not a customer-facing store. Its Google listing is real but it has no sales in the POS feed, so joining it to a store row would be wrong.
excludeLocationIds.7866692448696251318: 6136 University Ave, Halifax -- the Dalhousie campus outlet, PERMANENTLY CLOSED. Confirmed by Peter 2026-09-03. Its Google listing is still live and still carries the Mezza name with a 2.0 rating from 25 reviews (4 negative and unanswered, complaints about opening hours running to 2026-03), so it still surfaces in search. Excluded from every scorecard figure because a closed store has no operating performance to report, but the listing itself is worth marking permanently closed on Google -- that is what stops it ranking.

storesWithoutListing.Larry Uteck: The franchisee owns this Google Business Profile and it is not shared with the Mezza account, so this sync cannot read it. Confirmed by Peter 2026-09-03. Its rating and its unanswered reviews are therefore ABSENT from every review figure -- absent, not zero. Fix is access, not code: the owner can add the Mezza account as a manager on the listing, or transfer it into the organisation account.

_note_gaps: Two kinds of gap are tracked explicitly rather than left to look like bugs. excludeLocationIds: a real Google listing that should not appear in the scorecard. storesWithoutListing: a store that trades in the POS feed but whose listing this sync cannot see -- the dangerous direction, because missing data looks like nothing to do.
